content.systemBoundary: A small indoor rover system that acquires environmental measurements while moving through a room, associates measurements with relative location, stores records, and produces analysis summaries for mapping decisions.

nodes.name: Session Configuration Input
responsibilities: Accept user-intended mapping session context (indoor room run).
Provide placeholders for unknown runtime/accuracy/spatial-resolution constraints.

nodes.name: Environmental Measurement Acquisition
responsibilities: Acquire temperature, humidity, and air-quality measurements as the rover is moving.
Emit measurement samples for downstream processing and storage.

nodes.name: Timestamp + Location Association
responsibilities: Associate each measurement with a timestamp.
Associate each measurement with a relative indoor location context suitable for mapping bins.
Propagate unknown spatial-resolution assumptions to analysis metadata.

nodes.name: Timestamped Measurement Storage
responsibilities: Buffer and persist a measurement log containing timestamped, location-associated records.
Provide stored records to analysis and visualization steps.

nodes.name: Indoor Mapping Analysis
responsibilities: Aggregate stored records into mapping summaries.
Highlight mismatches between assumed and confirmed accuracy/spatial-resolution needs.
Produce decision-ready outputs to guide next embedded prototype steps.

nodes.name: Rover Control & Motion Orchestration
responsibilities: Schedule measurement acquisition while navigating inside the room.
Ensure runtime budget constraints are followed (values unknown until confirmed).

nodes.name: Mapping Data Export
responsibilities: Export summarized mapping outputs to an external consumer (e.g., desktop review tool).
Provide references to open questions affecting mapping assumptions.

edges.description: Control parameters are applied to motion/orchestration and measurement cadence, while unknown constraints remain placeholders.
Raw environmental measurement samples are emitted for timestamp and location association.
Associated measurement records are persisted as timestamped location-aware logs.
Stored measurement logs are aggregated to produce mapping summaries and highlight unknowns.
Analysis outputs are exported for review by an external consumer.

assumptions.statement: Functional architecture can capture unknown runtime, accuracy, and spatial-resolution as open questions without committing to specific components.
